title: Utility Bills & Household Accounts Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: Utility bills (`utility:bill`), utility meter readings (`utility:meter`), utility rate changes (`utility:rate`), household accounts (`household:account`), utility payments (`utility:payment`).
app: Electric, gas, and water bills, smart-meter readings, household-account records, and utility rate-plan changes streamed to Splunk HEC via portals, CSV exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=utility:bill) OR (index=personal sourcetype=utility:rate)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="utility:bill","primary",sourcetype="utility:rate","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from utility:bill and utility:rate to see whether two utility bills feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `utility:bill` and `utility:rate` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main utility bills data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
